findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed no barrier to be used by staff when turning off hand sink faucet. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and hands were rewashed. Ensure a barrier is used when turning off hand sink faucet to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed no hot water to be available within facility. Discussed with PIC, hot water will be serviced by a licensed plumber. Ensure hot water is available within facility during all hours of operation. A follow up has been issued for 11/19/26.
findings.citation_text: 5-202.12(A) Handwashing Sink, Installation. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 29.4°C (85°F) through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed lettuce to held past its 7 day date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, lettuce and salads that contained said lettuce were discarded. Ensure any TCS item is discarded after its 7 day date marking maximum.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Allergen awareness training for CFPM
findings.comment:
Observed no allergen training to have been completed by CFM present during inspection. Discussed with PIC, ensure all CFM’s have completed the required allergen training. 

410 ILCS 625/3.07(b). Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter. Training programs must be accredited by the American National Standards Institute or another reputable accreditation agency under the ASTM International E2659-09 (Standard Practice for Certificate Programs). There is no limit to how many times an employee may take the training.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed no soap to be available at hand sink. Discussed with PIC, soap was brought to hand sink. Ensure hand sinks are properly equipped with soap.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed eggs to be stored above lettuce in cooler. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper storage order and eggs were moved to bottom of cooler. Ensure proper storage order is maintained in cooler to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed opened sweet tea to be held past 7 day date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on date marking practices and tea was discarded. Ensure any TCS item kept longer than 7 days is discarded.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).
